title: Keeping Stock Ready at a Refill Shop
author: Dual Dictionary project — AI-assisted original source
article: Volunteers at the East Dock Refill Shop check the shelves before the doors open. They compare each jar with the stock card and write down items that are nearly empty. If soap or cooking oil starts to run low, the shift lead contacts the supplier before the weekend. At closing time, volunteers top up the display bottles from sealed containers in the storeroom. They label each bottle with the product name and refill date. The team keeps cleaning liquids on a separate shelf from food products. A weekly count helps the shop decide which items to order for the next delivery.

title: Selecting Excerpts for a Student Podcast
author: Dual Dictionary project — AI-assisted original source
article: A student media group is preparing a short podcast about how older buildings are reused. After recording three interviews with local planners, the students listen to the files together. They pick out brief sections that explain a design choice clearly, then note the time stamp so the editor can find each part. If an interviewee asks for a comment to stay off the record, the group leaves that section out of the public episode. The editor checks each excerpt against the full conversation to make sure its meaning has not changed. Before release, the team sends the final audio to the speakers for a factual check.

title: Introducing Staggered Start Times at Work
author: Dual Dictionary project — AI-assisted original source
article: A regional design firm will test flexible start times at its two largest offices. Managers plan to phase in the change over six weeks so staff can report problems before it applies to every team. The new schedule will take effect on 1 December, after the trial and a review with employee representatives. Staff may begin between 7:30 and 9:30, but each team must keep its client-support hours covered. Supervisors will compare attendance patterns and service records with the previous month. If the arrangement creates gaps at reception, the firm will adjust the team rota before extending the policy to other offices.
